name: pilates-workouts
description: Pilates Workout Generator - Monorepo with React client and Azure Functions API

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=api
scripts.test:api: npm run build:api && node scripts/test-api.js && npm test --workspace=api
